description: Batch the next 2+ known actions (click, type, scroll, view_page chains) here instead of N separate calls: a sequence of tool steps, executed server-side in one call. Variables via vars and saveAs ($name), conditions (if), suspend/resume to ask the agent mid-plan, and errorStrategy abort | continue | capture_image.

errorStrategy.description: abort stops at the first error; continue runs all steps; capture_image screenshots, then aborts

steps.description: Tool steps to run in order

if.description: Run the step only if this expression is true, e.g. "$pageTitle === 'Login'"

saveAs.description: Save the result as $name for later steps

suspend.description: Pause here to ask the agent a question

condition.description: Suspend after the step if this $-expression is true

name: run_plan
